description: This file defines a Stats struct for tracking various request counts and their success/failure statuses within the etcd v2store package, including methods for cloning, JSON serialization, and incrementing counters.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: A struct for tracking various request statistics and counters.

methods.name: newStats
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Stats instance.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Stats with current counter values.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Serializes the Stats to JSON format.

methods.name: Inc
methods.description: Increments the counter for a specified request type.
